### Stock Cranelift / Lean comparison

Commit: `a45546522590`. [Run and artifacts](https://github.com/eth-act/clifv/actions/runs/41430299959/attempts/1).

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Official CLIF test inventory | 1,302 / 1,302 (100.0%) files |
| AArch64 files with outputs compared | 202 / 484 (41.7%) |
| Exact function outputs | 1,633 / 4,455 (36.7%) |
| Files with every AArch64 output matching | 92 / 484 (19.0%) |
| Different function outputs | 364 |
| Rejected for a setting | 563 |
| Rejected for an unsupported operation | 1,895 |
| Complete compiler metadata agreement | Not established |
| Compiled test functions executed | No |

Exact matches require identical bytes, relocations, alignment, and trap records.
Rejected outputs do not pass. Expected stock failures without code are excluded from the output total.

Compared with `main` at `3b586e45bb65` ([run](https://github.com/eth-act/clifv/actions/runs/41416360000/attempts/1)): **+0 / −0** exact outputs (1,633 → 1,633).

The measuring code changed since then: `FVTest/Backend/Main.lean`. Changed numbers may come from the measurement, not the compiler.

Pipeline time: **180.4 seconds** (build, validation, artifact generation, and comparison).
Peak runner memory used: **2.65 GiB**, sampled every 0.1 seconds, including the OS.
This job uses two comparison workers. Rust toolchain setup is included in the pipeline time.
Lean installation and cache transfers are outside the pipeline time.

A successful measurement job means the measurement completed, not that both compilers fully agree.
The "Check lost matches" job fails when an output that matched on that `main` commit no longer matches.
The label `stock-comparison-accept-losses` accepts intended losses on a pull request.
